Firm, like ground you can build on
A dial that shows how much is left in the tank
d: Herb in the stuffing, or a wise elder
How to read a clue to catch what the eye misses
Chess pieces that must be protected
n: Wake is the first minute of a session, when an AI reads what it wrote yesterday before it does anything new. Without that minute every day starts cold and the same questions come back. Give your AI a place to leave notes, and make reading them the first step.
